anchoredLines.line: Something pads into the clearing — stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you. It's here.
Something pads into the clearing — The Ugly Beast. It's here.
Something pads into the clearing — Hushpuppy. It's here.
Something pads into the clearing — The Ugly Beast. It's here.
🗺️ Scouts found its lair — tile 7,3. THE HERALD — the sky, getting bigger. It is WAITING. You cannot face it alone. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Thornfield in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
Something pads into the clearing — The Loud Beast. It's here.
Something pads into the clearing — The Congregation. It's here.
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Lucia Sato and Felix Silva will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Malik Reyes and Sam Adeyemi will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— The Hungry Road answers! Ibrahim Fischer will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
Something pads into the clearing — The Congregation. It's here.
🌪️ THE HERALD fed in the night — 0 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck The Hungry Road in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)

"THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced The Ugly Beast and lived to sit here. They faced The Loud Beast and lived to sit here. 3 more of the later drafts faced besides. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (1 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.
